themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing and conservative parties across Europe are leveraging high-profile policy disputes and parliamentary deadlocks to drive electoral momentum. From Sweden's government formation negotiations around Ulf Kristersson to AfD's candidacy battles in Saxony-Anhalt and Vox's campaign offensive in Spain, right-wing forces are seeking to maximize leverage ahead of key votes.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Pushes gubernatorial candidate Ulrich Siegmund in Saxony-Anhalt while threatening legal action against federal budget plans.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Rallies supporters across Spain ahead of upcoming regional and general votes, positioning itself against the ruling left.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Contests local council seats, leads opposition to Welsh Senedd leadership, and mobilizes against EU alignment.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Rounds out early 2027 presidential campaign outreach to small business owners and suburban voters.

themes.title: Transnational Conservative Alliances and Bilateral Right-Wing Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders and political movements are actively cultivating cross-border diplomatic networks and responding to international friction. Bilateral engagements between Polish conservative leaders and Argentina's Javier Milei contrast with escalating diplomatic rifts between Argentina and Brazil, as well as shifts in Trump-aligned foreign policy personnel.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Hosts Polish conservative figures in Buenos Aires while facing severe diplomatic escalation and ambassador recalls from Brazil.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Promotes high-level bilateral presidential meetings in Argentina to bolster economic and ideological ties.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Experiences deepening diplomatic rift with Argentina alongside the departure of key Trump-linked liaisons from US offices.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Engages in high-stakes cross-border diplomacy with Ukrainian leadership over regional security and EU accession.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Conservative and far-right parties report mounting state oversight, law enforcement actions, and judicial interventions targeting their officials and media partners. Probes into law enforcement leaks to the Rassemblement National in France mirror police raids and constitutional organ battles in Poland, alongside ongoing legal battles involving Bolsonarista leaders in Brazil.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Faces judicial inspection into unauthorized police presence and administrative leaks at party headquarters.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Denounces security agency actions at right-wing media outlets and parliamentary blocks on constitutional panels.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Navigates Supreme Court rulings and electoral court proceedings targeting high-profile figures.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: State legislatures consider constitutional rules designed to curb AfD parliamentary blocking power.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing platforms continue to center hardline migration controls and national preference rhetoric as core policy pillars. Demands range from mass deportation proposals in Germany to strict citizen-first priorities in public housing in Spain and enforcement disputes in the United States.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands national priority for Spaniards in public housing access and links immigration policies directly to public safety.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Party leadership advocates for wide-scale deportation of millions of refugees back to their countries of origin.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Deportation cases and legal battles surrounding federal immigration enforcement dominate coverage.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Emphasizes strict language standards for public workers and debated local repatriation initiatives.

themes.title: Pensions Overhaul and Fiscal Populism Debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are advancing cost-of-living populism through calls for deep tax cuts, pension rule adjustments, and lower fuel and food duties. In Norway and Spain, populist platforms focus on immediate tax relief for working families, while governing coalitions in Italy and Argentina battle over tax amnesties and budget austerity.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes a 63 billion NOK budget reduction plan aimed at halving food VAT and fuel taxes for consumers.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega presses for building tax amnesties (condono) and flexible pension retirement rules in annual budget talks.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Defends strict fiscal discipline and executive spending in Congress amid pushback from provincial governors.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands income tax reductions and criticizes high tax burdens alongside failing municipal services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes cutting VAT on energy to 5.5% and rolling back recent pension reform hikes.
